content: FFmpeg concat: Two main methods. (1) Concat demuxer (-f concat -safe 0 -i filelist.txt -c copy output.mp4): fastest, no re-encode, stream copy. Requires all inputs same codec/resolution/framerate. Filelist format: 'file "/path/to/clip1.mp4"' per line. (2) Concat filter: re-encodes, handles mismatched formats but slow. For segments from same YouTube source video (same codec), concat demuxer with -c copy is appropriate. Keyframe limitation: -c copy can only cut at keyframes, so segment boundaries may be off by up to ~2s depending on GOP size. For transcript-guided clips this is acceptable (transcript timestamps are already approximate).
